economic_hypothesis: In a causally known broad BULL market and healthy PIT industry, a former leader with at least 30% prior 120-session appreciation or two prior limit-up closes may reset inventory through a 15%-35% drawdown. A ten-session narrow, lower-turnover base followed by the first high-location, expanded-turnover close above its ceiling marks reaccumulation and a potential second markup phase.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
former_leader: prior completed ret120>=30% or at least two limit-up closes in prior120
industry: PIT median ret20>0 and positive share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

trigger: first close above prior10 high, return>=3%, turnover>=1.5x prior10, location>=75%
